description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Lotus Field.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Lotus Field.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Locus of Enlightenment
